words.meaning: due to decay of a family
by the knowers of the Truth
with heaven as their highest goal
sera leading to (new) births as the result of their works
for the attainment of pleasure and power
(people) deeply attached to pleasure and power
the producer of the results of acts
Endued with evenness of mind ¥in this (life)
one who has controlled his senses, mind and intellect
one towhom Moksha is the supreme goal
freed from desire, fear and anger
one who has subdued the actions of mind and senses
for the purification of the heart
a state of severance from, the contact of pain
By a man of uncontrolled self
those of which. these two (Prakritis) are the womb
at the time of death wear with devotion
at the end of the Kalpa
at the beginning of the Kalpa
with a mind devoted to nothing else ware Origin of beings
taking me as the supreme goal
of those who seek to conquer
the subject of the discrimination of Self and non-Self
hosts of all grades of beings
blazing like burning fire and sun
the one thing to be known
the sun and the moon (thy) eyes
the burning fire (thy) mouth easter with thy radiance
bands of great Rishis and Siddhas
hosts of Gandharvas, Yakshas, Asuras and Siddhas
heroes in the world of men
in the welfare of all beings
by (from) joy, envy, fear and anxiety
to whom censure and praise are equal
the Kshetrajna fate do thou know
with son wife, home, and the rest
in the occurrence of the desirable and the undesirable
In the production of the body and the senses
and waft supporter wear the experiencer
between the Kshetra and the Kshetrajna
the emancipation from the Prakriti of beings
with the eye of knowledge who
in the wombs of the irrational
with the pride and intoxication of wealth
At the wrong place or time
the work of Yajna, gift and austerity
